findings.description: The `+N more` format already has a named seam in `moreLine(hidden)` (src/cli/ui/viewport.utils.ts:16-18, which returns `  +${hidden} more`). Both changed components stop calling it and re-inline the same `+${hidden} more` template, with a suffix added. The row format is now spelled in three places: `moreLine`, `debt.component.tsx:40` and `radar.component.tsx:43`. general.md:104 says 'Thresholds, timeouts, tool names, path fragments — none are inlined at the use site.' A display string is not one of those categories, so this is weak. The same prior-round theme (inline layout literals) is already posted, so this may fold into it. A smaller option is to keep `moreLine` and give it an optional noun, for example `moreLine(hidden, 'overdue debt')`. That would keep the format in one place.
